title: RCSD: Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Domain-Specific Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.29527v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by employing a compact draft model to propose candidate tokens that are verified in parallel by a target model. Conventional training relies on soft-label distillation, which forces the draft model to mimic the target's full output distribution, including high-entropy regions that degrade acceptance rates and increase early rejection risk. We propose RCSD (Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Speculative Decoding), a training framework that aligns draft model optimization with the system-level objective of maximizing acceptance length. RCSD leverages naturally occurring accepted and rejected sequences during speculative inference to construct implicit preference pairs, with masked loss to avoid penalizing target-aligned tokens. translated_title: RCSD：面向领域特定投机解码的强化学习与持续学习方法
translated_abstract: 投机解码通过采用一个紧凑的草稿模型提出候选token，再由目标模型并行验证，从而加速大语言模型推理。传统训练方法依赖软标签蒸馏，迫使草稿模型模仿目标模型的完整输出分布，其中包括会降低接受率、增加早期拒绝风险的高熵区域。我们提出了RCSD（面向投机解码的强化学习与持续学习方法），这是一个将草稿模型优化与最大化接受长度这一系统级目标相对齐的训练框架。RCSD利用投机推理过程中自然产生的被接受和被拒绝序列来构建隐式偏好对，并通过掩码损失避免惩罚与目标模型对齐的token。在多个基准测试上的评估表明，RCSD的平均接受长度相比HASS提升了35%，并实现了1.35倍的端到端推理加速。
tldr: RCSD通过强化学习与持续学习，利用投机解码中自然产生的接受/拒绝序列构建隐式偏好对来优化草稿模型，使平均接受长度较HASS提升35%，端到端推理速度提升1.35倍。
en_tdlr: RCSD leverages reinforcement and continual learning with implicit preference pairs from naturally occurring accepted/rejected sequences to optimize draft models, improving average acceptance length by 35% over HASS and achieving 1.35x faster end-to-end inference.
